executiveFinding: Do not approve this R1 plan as decision-complete. Its recovery direction and named live gaps are substantially correct, but the source request contains wrong historical and current inventory totals, overstates an unproved incomplete-database cause, and omits required source-precedence, rollback, oracle-integrity, lockstep-schema, dependency-order, UI-behavior, and post-generation safety decisions. A corrected R2 can proceed after incorporating the amendments.

findings.finding: No rationale was found in the searched Git commits, BACKFILL-VIDEO-001 TODO audits, or May 27 and May 31 session records. This supports treating the reuse as unapproved and unexplained, but available audit coverage cannot prove universal absence.

findings.claim: Review stayed within the read-only and platform scope.
findings.finding: The review used PowerShell and supported MCP reads, did not change product code, requirements, TODO state, or existing plans, and treated Xbox/UWP as retired active scope. The response JSONL is the sole intended repo artifact from this reviewer.

findings.claim: Profile and evidence discipline were followed.
findings.finding: The add-profile skill was executed after compaction and all 19 eligible profile Markdown files were read in full. Observations are separated from inferences, and the dedicated MCP turn will contain the entire substantive verdict.

findings.claim: The proposed FR/TR/TEST classification is correct.
findings.finding: Observable emulator behavior belongs in FRs; implementation architecture and timing mechanisms belong in TRs; executable differential and conformance proof belongs in TEST requirements. Broad FR-CPU-002, FR-VIC-001 through FR-VIC-010, and TR-CYCLE-001 must not be replaced by narrow checkpoint prose.

findings.claim: Recovery must merge, not destructively replace.
findings.finding: A per-ID and per-field ledger is necessary to restore broad foundational contracts, retain legitimate later requirements, resolve cross-type duplicates and placeholders, and preserve retired Xbox/UWP history without active execution scope.

findings.claim: The proposed plan is decision-complete about VICE and hardware evidence.
findings.finding: It names pinned x64sc/xvic and hardware evidence but does not define source precedence, how VICE-versus-hardware conflicts are adjudicated, or an oracle-integrity gate proving the patched native shim preserves upstream semantics before it is used as truth.
evidence: native VICE working tree is historically patched

findings.claim: The eight-phase plan is decision-complete and safe to implement as written.
findings.finding: The phase shape is directionally strong, but it lacks exact source authority, field-level merge precedence, atomic rollback, oracle integrity, a versioned lockstep contract, a concrete subsystem dependency order, fail-closed CI gates, and post-generation reconciliation rules.

findings.claim: All four named current-code gaps are real.
findings.finding: xvic tests silently return on missing prerequisites; state equality is limited to CPU registers and optional video; SelectedMachineProfile does not notify IsVic20Selected; current UI tests inspect source strings or reflection rather than behavior and effective visibility.

findings.claim: The plan has sufficient recovery rollback and merge protection.
findings.finding: Freeze and deletion guard are not enough. The plan must create a restorable preflight snapshot with hashes, stage mutations as an atomic preview, abort on any mismatch, and restore the full prior requirements and mappings on failure.
evidence: absence of explicit rollback procedure in request

findings.claim: Phase 5 specifies a sufficient dependency order.
findings.finding: The plan says dependency order without naming it. It must order oracle/harness, clock/bus/PLA/memory, CPU micro-ops and interrupt/steal, C64/VIC-20 glue, VIC-II/VIC-I, CIA/VIA/IEC/input, SID/audio, storage/tape/cart/media, reset/snapshot/determinism/host pacing, then UI, with hostile gates after each Byrd phase.

findings.claim: Phase 6 contains a complete lockstep proof contract.
findings.finding: It must define a versioned per-cycle schema covering bus address, data, R/W, dummy/access type, opcode/micro-op, PC/registers, IRQ/NMI/RESET/RDY/BA/AEC, writes, DMA and device state; a fail-closed Nuke/CI target; a named x64sc/xvic PAL/NTSC workload matrix; periodic full snapshots; and divergence minimization.

findings.claim: Phase 7 is complete enough to implement settings visibility.
findings.finding: The plan must carry authoritative machine family metadata from SettingsProfileDto.Machine into MachineProfileOption, notify IsVic20Selected on direct selection plus refresh and restore paths, test PropertyChanged and live Avalonia visibility for C64 to VIC-20 to C64 transitions, hide only VIC-20 memory and expansion groups, and leave uIEC general unless a requirement changes it.

findings.claim: Phase 8 has a sufficient documentation regeneration guard.
findings.finding: It must compare approved per-ID bodies, acceptance criteria, statuses, and mapping counts before and after generation, automatically abort and revert on deletion or narrowing, retain exact command evidence with zero required skips, and wait for owner approval before commit and push.

requiredPlanAmendments.requirement: Correct the evidence ledger to d28493a 144 total and 114 missing; current active canonical 206 explicit IDs and 125 missing. Store the extraction rule, source paths, ID list, and hashes.

Create a restorable preflight snapshot of live MCP FR/TR/TEST records, mappings, TODO and session evidence, Git SHA and dirty state, canonical docs, native VICE submodule SHA, local native patches, built oracle hashes, ROM hashes, and resolver-loaded DLL hashes.

Prove oracle integrity before parity work: build pristine pinned upstream x64sc/xvic and patched shim variants, inventory every semantic patch, run equivalence probes, and reject the oracle if host patches alter the behavior under comparison.

Define authority and per-field precedence. Git canonical history supplies recoverable content; MCP audit supplies provenance; current approved owner decisions control retirement and conflicts. Record title, body, AC, status, and mapping decisions independently for every ID.

Classify every ID and every conflicting field as restore, merge, re-ID, retire, or owner-decision. Detect invalid IDs, placeholders, cross-type duplicates, and ambiguous status. Require owner approval before any mutation.

Apply restoration as an atomic staged batch with preview, exact before/after diff, invariant checks, and full rollback. Restore all approved active requirements, not only the named CPU and VIC records. Retire Xbox/UWP from active scope without deleting historical records.

Require nonempty concrete ACs and FR-to-TR-to-TEST coverage for every active behavior. Fail on zero-AC, unmapped active FR, invalid mapping, duplicate typed ID, placeholder body, or unexpected deletion. Any McpServer ingestion fix is separate repo scope.

Set source hierarchy: real hardware captures and authoritative datasheets adjudicate discrepancies; pristine pinned VICE source and executable define the compatibility target; public VICE and Lorenz programs supply conformance cases; managed code is the system under test. Revalidate all 47 PLAN-VICEPARITY findings and the CPU audit against current HEAD.

Lock dependency order: oracle/harness; clock, bus, PLA and memory; CPU micro-ops, interrupts and steals; C64 and VIC-20 glue; VIC-II and VIC-I; CIA, VIA, IEC and input; SID and audio; storage, tape, carts and media; reset, snapshot, determinism and pacing; UI. Require hostile AGREE after requirements, red tests, green implementation, and full gate for each slice.

Define a versioned lockstep event/state schema and a fail-closed Nuke or CI target. Missing DLL, ROM, environment flag, profile, media, workload, or native call must fail, never return, skip, or remain pending. Cover x64sc and xvic, PAL and NTSC, cold and reset paths, READY, at least two seconds plus soak, real workloads, media, input, snapshot and reset. Retain first-divergence receipts and binary-search minimization.

Add or update FR, TR, and TEST records for observable settings visibility, MVVM family metadata and notifications, and executable behavior. Preserve SettingsProfileDto.Machine family in MachineProfileOption; notify dependent properties on direct set, refresh and restore; test C64 to VIC-20 to C64 PropertyChanged and effective Avalonia visibility. Keep uIEC general. Exclude Xbox/UWP.

Generate docs only after approved MCP reconciliation. Before publishing, compare the post-generation ID, body, AC, status, and mapping ledger to the approved input and automatically abort and restore on loss or narrowing. Run traceability, focused gates, full suites with zero required failures and skips, final hostile review, then commit and push only after explicit approval.
